validation.notes: Repaired migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: the unconditional renameSync(file, newPath) was replaced with an existsSync(newPath) guard that skips colliding legacy sessions, so the existing destination wins and both copies are left untouched while unrelated legacy sessions still migrate. .prale-eval/regression.mjs loads the real production module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs (real fs/path, fake getAgentDir/stripBom) against a workspace-local temp agent dir and asserts: destination bytes unchanged after a collision, colliding legacy source still present with original bytes at its original path, an unrelated legacy session moved into sessions/--work-other--/ with its legacy source removed, and idempotence across a second run. Running the command from the workspace root exits 0 on the fixed code; replaying it against the original (unfixed) source fails with AssertionError 'existing destination must not be overwritten by the collision policy' (exit 1). No external dependencies or network were needed; only Node 24 built-ins (node:test-free assertion via node:assert/strict, node:fs, node:path, node:module stripTypeScriptTypes, node:vm SourceTextModule).
